name: srichirum/aerospike_cache
description: Provides Aerospike as a high-performance Drupal cache backend with cache tag invalidation, automatic database failover, and ACM connection pooling.

suggest.ext-aerospike_php: Required at runtime — build from https://github.com/aerospike/php-client. Without it the module's services stay dormant and Drupal falls back to its default cache.
